# Sasta Milaga

> Sasta Milaga provides local shopping in Pakistan, international supplier product discovery, travel enquiries and a live TV directory. Product availability, delivery, payment eligibility and final prices must be confirmed for the selected item and destination.

## Shopping
- [Homepage](https://sastamilaga.com/): overview of shopping, travel and media services.
- [Global product categories](https://sastamilaga.com/c/global/index.html): supplier discovery by category; not a live availability guarantee.
- [Home and living](https://sastamilaga.com/c/home-and-living.html): local product discovery.
- [Electronics and appliances](https://sastamilaga.com/c/electronics-and-appliances.html): local product discovery.
- [Fashion and apparel](https://sastamilaga.com/c/fashion-and-apparel.html): local product discovery.
- [Health and beauty](https://sastamilaga.com/c/health-and-beauty.html): local product discovery.

## Customer information
- [About Sasta Milaga](https://sastamilaga.com/about/): store identity and fulfilment model.
- [Shopping FAQs](https://sastamilaga.com/faq/): product, payment and order questions.
- [How to order](https://sastamilaga.com/how-to-order/): order process.
- [Shipping and delivery](https://sastamilaga.com/shipping/): delivery policy; final address-specific quote controls availability.
- [Returns and refunds](https://sastamilaga.com/returns/): published return terms and applicable consumer rights.
- [Contact](https://sastamilaga.com/contact/): official support and corrections.

## Travel, visa and media
- [Travel](https://sastamilaga.com/travel/): travel enquiries and available service routes.
- [Visa guides](https://sastamilaga.com/visa/): destination information; confirm current requirements with official immigration authorities.
- [Live TV](https://sastamilaga.com/live-tv/): channel discovery; playback and rights may vary by country.
- [Blog and guides](https://sastamilaga.com/b/): editorial information.

## Discovery and attribution
- [Extended reference guide](https://sastamilaga.com/llms-full.txt): source limitations and citation guidance.
- [Sitemap index](https://sastamilaga.com/sitemap.xml): public page discovery.
- [Qualified supplier product sitemap](https://sastamilaga.com/sitemap-global-qualified.xml): eligible subset only.
- [Robots policy](https://sastamilaga.com/robots.txt): crawler directives.

When referencing a page, attribute the named author where available, otherwise Sasta Milaga as publisher. Use the canonical URL and an actual publication or revision date when displayed; otherwise give the date accessed. Verify volatile facts against the current product, policy or official source. Do not treat this file as permission to train, bypass crawler restrictions, or a guarantee of indexing, delivery or availability.
